verdict.rationale: The axis applies to an accounting product, but the evidence pack never mentions the chart of accounts, account types, sub-accounts, classes, or tags. The closest items are custom fields in QBO Advanced and generic API/MCP CRUD over unnamed entity types. Those are adjacent features and developer building blocks, not documented chart-of-accounts customization.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can customize the chart of accounts with account types, sub-accounts, and class or tag dimensions
